name: Rapid button flutter
desc: Hard 16 Hz on-off chop, free-running, no edge smoothing: a kill button tapped as fast as possible over legato runs

refs.why: right hand on a hard-wired kill switch while the left hand taps legato

notes: Smooth 0 is a true hard cut: the click is part of the sound. EXP on rate (1-30 Hz) plays the tapping speed by foot
